taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from General Features, Joints, radiographs & surface marking (Lower Limb).

words.clue: Socket-like structure formed by tibia and fibula that receives the talus

Bony prominence at the ankle; medial and lateral forms create the mortise
Movement at the subtalar joint bringing the sole of the foot inward
Movement at the subtalar joint turning the sole of the foot outward
Ankle movement toward the anterior leg, performed primarily by tibialis anterior
Ankle movement pointing the foot downward, performed by gastrocnemius and soleus
Thickened lateral band of fascia lata extending from iliac tubercle to Gerdy's tubercle
Fibrous band at the ankle that restrains and organizes tendons
Boat-shaped tarsal bone articulating with the talus in the talonavicular joint
Cube-shaped tarsal bone articulating with the calcaneus in the calcaneocuboid joint
